_readme: Retention periods in days. A policy is applied only when a handler exists in src/retention.js. Applying a policy writes an audit entry. The audit trail itself is never purged.

login_tokens.description: Used or expired single-use login links

attachments.description: Uploaded files attached to expenses or library docs (7 years)

inactive_user_accounts.description: Disabled accounts anonymised after two years; records they touched are kept

bequest_intentions_review.description: Live bequest intentions are reviewed by a person, not deleted automatically

audit_log.description: Append-only hash-chained audit trail. Never purged.
